lines.en: I walk slowly, the apples swaying.

lines.zh: 背上的枝，压得我有点驼。
lines.en: The branches on my back bow me a little.
I make one slow circuit of the pasture.
I go from the plain to the wood's edge.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩过的地方都是草汁味。
lines.en: Everywhere my hooves step smells of crushed grass.
I walk toward the sunlight.
I go round the mud. I'd sink.
These golden apples are heavy.
I lower my head and graze as I walk.
Tree shadows slide across my back.
My golden hooves fall lightly.
I head toward the sound of water.
Every step, the apples knock together.
A soft sound. Like a bell.
I stop in the shade to breathe.
I crop the grass in neat rows.
The apples on my back sway gently.

lines.zh: 背上这些东西，是我长出来的。
lines.en: What's on my back grew from me.
No one hung it there.

lines.zh: 阳光照在金苹果上，很亮。
lines.en: Sun on the golden apples. Very bright.
Birds want to peck. Can't reach.
Tail flick to shoo the flies.

lines.zh: 金苹果的皮，太阳下晃眼。
lines.en: Golden apple hide glares in the sun.
My horns are short. Hard, though.

lines.zh: 我不太动，动了果子会掉。
lines.en: I move little. The apples might fall.
One's ripe. Very sweet.
I turn my head.
A herd in the distance. I don't join.
I'm fine like this.
The wind presses a patch of grass down.
I wait for it to pass.
I lower my head and take another bite.
You're looking at my back.
These aren't for giving.
They grew with me.
Picking one would hurt.
Where did you hide the golden apple?
I graze head-down. I don't charge people.
But I do lower my head.
You see my horns.
Your hands are empty. A pity.

lines.zh: 那我们就没什么好说的。
lines.en: Then there's nothing to say.
You're staying. I'll keep eating.
Stand there if you like.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，果子响成一片。
lines.en: I sway and the apples clatter.
A dull, heavy ache.

lines.zh: 金苹果的皮擦破了一点。
lines.en: The skin of my golden apple scraped.
A twig on my back snapped.
No matter. It'll grow.
I lower my head and recover.
This big, I'm poor at dodging.
My chest is heaving.
My legs hold. I can still walk.
Only a bit slower.
This grass is tender. I'll take it.
I lower my head and take it in one pull.
Tenderer than what's on the ground.
Hold it a little higher.
I can reach. Don't worry.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼，很有耐心，金苹果的味道。
lines.en: I chew slowly, patiently; the taste of golden apple.
Not enough grass. Any more?
That little? Not enough.
What's on my back isn't for trade.
If you want it, I can't help.

lines.zh: 我一口卷住草，扯了一下。
lines.en: I take the grass and pull once.
Sweeter than wild grass.
I take it in one pull.
Far more tender than the ground stuff.
Hold it while I eat, slowly.
Give me one more—I've still got room.

lines.zh: 我身上的苹果晃得叮当响。
lines.en: The apples on me clink as I sway.
An apple nearly fell.
I steady myself and shift aside.
My golden horn gave you a nudge.
Step back. Don't touch the branch.
If it breaks it grows back.
But it aches a long while.
Let's each take a side.
This road. There's room on it.
I'm slow. You go first.

lines.zh: 我这一身，别人不太敢靠近。
lines.en: Few dare come close to me.
Others shy away. You aren't afraid.
Then stand there.

lines.zh: 我背上的果子，是给后代的。
lines.en: The apples are for the young.
Not time yet.
Let's walk a stretch together.
Walk on my right. Better grass there.
I won't run. Don't you either.
Before dark, we reach that wood.
We'll spend the night there.
I lower my head and take it.
I chew. Not grass.
I carry it back into the grass.

lines.zh: 我用舌头把苹果卷进嘴里。
lines.en: I curl my tongue around the apple and pull it in.
I don't want your things.
Too heavy for my mouth.
I kick it aside.

lines.zh: 地上掉的果子，我看了一眼。
lines.en: A fallen apple. I glance at it.
Not mine. I won't touch it.

lines.zh: 我用舌头卷了卷，吐出来。
lines.en: I curl my tongue round it and spit it out.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵先转过去，然后才是身子。
lines.en: My ears turn first, then the rest of me.
One golden hide, and only one.
My horns point that way.
All four feet planted.
This body can't run. I won't.

lines.zh: 这么大身体，跑也跑不掉。
lines.en: A body this size can't run anyway.
Can't outrun it. So I stand.
If it comes, I lower my head.
Best if it doesn't.
It hasn't come. I'll wait more.
I keep facing that way.
It circles. I turn slowly.
The branches turn with me.
I shuffle slowly toward that patch of grass.
Then I'll keep eating.
Eyes still watching.
Grass right at my feet.
One bite.
One bite, then up again.
I lower my horns slightly.
I lower my head and push forward.
That wasn't light.
I raise a hoof and stamp.
The grass flattens under it.
I turn broadside and block with my back.
The apples swing. Uncomfortable.
I don't want a second butt.

lines.zh: 我的毛色，像镀了一层金。
lines.en: My coat looks gilded.
It ran. I won't chase.
I couldn't anyway.
I get up from the grass.
The branches on my back sway.

lines.zh: 金苹果碰在一起，响了一声。
lines.en: The golden apples knock together once.
Good grass on this plain.
My shadow is golden.
The wood is that way.
I walk out from under the apple tree.
My hide shines with a golden light.
Very bright. Visible from far.
Nothing to hide about it.
Fire touched me and my hide tightened.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，果子掉了一地。
lines.en: I rolled down a slope; apples scattered.

lines.zh: 水没到我背，金苹果沉下去。
lines.en: Water reaches my back; the apples sink.
The blast lifted all four hooves.
Golden hide won't stop an arrow.

lines.zh: 那光一照，枝上的果子都暗了。
lines.en: That light dimmed every apple on my branches.

lines.zh: 草被吃光了，我越来越瘦。
lines.en: The grass is gone. I grow thin.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，枝上的苹果晃。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and the apples sway.

lines.zh: 我的苹果在这里不发光。
lines.en: My apples give no light here.
